english.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for a person who has become used to something through repeated experience.

examples.english: I've lived in Hong Kong for years, so I'm accustomed to taking the bus to work every day.
examples.traditional: 我搬嚟香港幾年，已經慣咗日日搭巴士返工。
